findings.summary: The card preview's cup type ("Tea") is 1.73:1 on the card in light and dark, so it's hard to read; the preview copies the xBloom app's card on purpose, and the cup type isn't written anywhere else.
findings.fix: Keep the preview identical to the xBloom card, and give its content in words: the cup type in the summary line, and a label for screen readers on the preview. Done: the summary line now starts with the cup type, and the preview is announced as "Card preview: Tea, 3 pours". The faint text itself stays, as on the real card, so the audit still reports it.

findings.summary: The first screen asks for a share link but never says where it comes from or what it looks like, so a first-time visitor can get stuck at step 1.
findings.fix: Add one line under the field: share the recipe from the xBloom app and paste the link; it looks like https://share-h5.xbloom.com/?id=…

findings.summary: The theme toggle is 40×40 px; 44×44 px is easier to tap on a phone.
"Custom colour" opens from a 20 px tall line, which is a small target on a phone.
findings.fix: Give the whole row a 44 px height.

findings.summary: On a phone the pours table breaks values in the middle ("100 / ml") and wraps the flow and pattern unevenly, which makes the numbers hard to scan.
findings.fix: Keep each value on one line, show the pour pattern beside the flow rate in a quieter style (below it only when the row has no room), and tighten the cell padding on narrow screens.

findings.summary: "Copy link" has no failure state (the browser can refuse the clipboard) and says "Copied" forever, even after the link changes.
findings.fix: If copying fails, say so and suggest selecting the link; go back to "Copy link" after two seconds.

findings.summary: The sliders remove the browser's focus ring and add one back only in Chrome and Safari, so keyboard users in Firefox can't see which slider they're on.
findings.fix: Add the same focus ring to Firefox's slider thumb.

findings.summary: The 16 preset swatches are 31×31 px on a phone; 44×44 px is easier to tap.
findings.fix: Keep them: all 16 fit in two rows, with 10 px between them they pass the 24 px minimum, and bigger swatches would need four rows.

findings.summary: The sliders are 26 px tall on a phone; 44 px is easier to grab.
findings.fix: Keep them: they run the full width of the card, so they're easy to drag, and they pass the 24 px minimum.

findings.summary: The page uses seven text sizes for six type roles (14 px has no role) and spacing values off the 4 px scale (10, 14, 18, 22, 30 px).
findings.fix: Leave the current page as it is; new work uses the design guide's roles and scale.
